description: Add a KiroCrew-side per-session escape hatch that lets a long-running session recover MCP tools that kiro-cli deferred, without opening a new session. This is the only lever available on this side of the ACP boundary: the deferral engine (deciding to defer a spec, and re-injecting it after context shrinks) lives in kiro-cli, NOT in this repo. Concretely, add an async `reload_tool_search()` method on AcpProvider (kiro runtime backend only) that re-writes the Tool Search overlay via the existing `_write_tool_search_overlay` / `_apply_tool_search_overlay` path and then RESTARTS the kiro-cli backend (shutdown + start), so kiro-cli re-reads the overlay and recomputes tool deferral against the current (post-/compact) context, re-injecting previously deferred specs. Model the method's shape on the existing `change_effort` / `clear_effort` precedent (backend-membership gating, snapshot/rollback, structured logging). Also allow a per-session threshold override on that call so an operator can lower/raise minPct/minTokens for the restarted session. This feature is intentionally scoped to what KiroCrew can achieve alone; the durable automatic-re-injection-after-compact fix must be routed upstream to kiro-cli and is documented as such (see steps).
steps: Study the precedent before writing: read `change_effort` and `clear_effort` in src/kiro_crew/providers/acp.py (~lines 1121-1246) and `_apply_tool_search_overlay` (~1026-1060), `_write_tool_search_overlay` (~143-200), `start()` and `shutdown()` (~1245-1291), and the tool_search fields in __init__ (~360-386). Mirror their style: heavy docstring explaining WHY, backend-membership gating on ACP_BACKENDS_KIRO_SLASH_COMMANDS, and defensive rollback.

In src/kiro_crew/providers/acp.py add `async def reload_tool_search(self, *, min_pct: object = None, min_tokens: object = None) -> bool` on AcpProvider. Behavior: (a) no-op returning False when backend not in ACP_BACKENDS_KIRO_SLASH_COMMANDS or when self._tool_search is None or when self._tool_search is False (nothing is being deferred by KiroCrew's overlay, so a reload would not restore anything) - log at info level and return False; (b) refuse and return False when a turn is active (`self.has_active_turn()`), matching the mid-turn hazard change_effort/model-switch document, so the restart never races a streaming prompt; (c) snapshot the current self._tool_search_min_pct / self._tool_search_min_tokens, apply any provided min_pct/min_tokens overrides onto self._tool_search_min_pct/_tool_search_min_tokens, call self._apply_tool_search_overlay() to rewrite <work_dir>/.kiro/settings/cli.json, then restart the backend so kiro-cli re-reads the overlay (await self.shutdown() then await self.start()); on any exception during restart, roll back the snapshotted thresholds, re-apply the overlay, and re-raise (or return False) so a failed reload does not leave poisoned thresholds. Return True on a successful restart.

Because start()/shutdown() operate on the kiro runtime path, confirm the restart correctly re-runs _apply_tool_search_overlay() (start() already calls it before (re)spawn) and re-spawns the runtime via _start_kiro_runtime(). Do NOT duplicate the overlay write if start() already performs it; the explicit _apply_tool_search_overlay() call in reload_tool_search ensures the overlay reflects any threshold override even if start()'s ordering changes. Keep the write idempotent (it already is).

Expose the capability on the provider interface if a consumer needs to call it polymorphically: check src/kiro_crew/providers/base.py. If other providers must satisfy the interface, add a default `async def reload_tool_search(self, *, min_pct=None, min_tokens=None) -> bool: return False` to the base LLMProvider so non-ACP backends are inert. Only add it to base.py if you actually wire a caller through the base type; if the only caller is typed as AcpProvider (like _try_live_model_switch), keep it on AcpProvider only. Document the decision in findings.

Add tests to a new file test/test_acp_tool_search_reload.py following the exact conventions in test/test_acp_tool_search.py (the _build_provider helper that patches kiro_crew.providers.acp.AcpClient with MagicMock, the tmp_path cli.json helper, @pytest.mark.asyncio for async tests). Cover: (1) kiro backend with tool_search=True and no active turn -> reload_tool_search() rewrites the overlay and calls shutdown() then start() (patch/spy those) and returns True; (2) threshold override (min_pct=12, min_tokens=1234) is written into cli.json before restart and updates self._tool_search_min_pct/_tokens; (3) claude backend (ACP_BACKEND_CLAUDE) -> returns False and does NOT restart; (4) self._tool_search is None -> returns False, no restart; (5) self._tool_search is False -> returns False, no restart; (6) has_active_turn() True -> returns False, no restart; (7) restart failure path: make start() raise and assert the thresholds are rolled back to the pre-call snapshot and the overlay reflects the rollback. Assert against real cli.json contents via json.loads, not just mock call counts, for the overlay-write assertions.

Document the upstream-only portion. Add a concise note to the reload_tool_search docstring stating that automatic re-injection of deferred specs after /compact (with no explicit reload) is kiro-cli behavior on the far side of the ACP boundary and is not fixable in this repo; this method is the manual escape hatch KiroCrew can offer. Then write the maintainer-facing decision summary into .agents/tasks/task-tool-search-reload/UPSTREAM_NOTES.md: (a) what was fixed here (manual per-session reload that rewrites the overlay and restarts kiro-cli so deferral is recomputed against post-compact context); (b) what remains upstream (kiro-cli should re-inject deferred specs automatically when context shrinks below tool_search_min_pct/min_tokens after a compact, or expose an in-session reload without a full restart); (c) a recommendation that a maintainer decide whether to file the upstream kiro-cli issue, referencing issue #8082.
acceptance_criteria: AcpProvider has an async reload_tool_search method that, on a kiro runtime backend with tool_search enabled and no active turn, rewrites <work_dir>/.kiro/settings/cli.json via the existing overlay writer and restarts the backend (shutdown then start), returning True.
The method returns False without restarting for: claude backend, tool_search is None, tool_search is False, or an active turn.
A threshold override passed to reload_tool_search is written into the overlay (toolSearch.minPct / toolSearch.minTokens) and reflected on the provider instance.
A restart failure rolls back the thresholds to their pre-call values and re-applies the overlay.
New tests in test/test_acp_tool_search_reload.py cover all the above and pass; existing test/test_acp_tool_search.py still passes.
.agents/tasks/task-tool-search-reload/UPSTREAM_NOTES.md documents the KiroCrew-side fix and the remaining upstream kiro-cli work referencing issue #8082.
verification: Run `<venv>/bin/python -m pytest test/test_acp_tool_search_reload.py test/test_acp_tool_search.py -q` and confirm all pass.
Run black/isort/flake8 on the changed files per CONTRIBUTING.md (line length 100) and confirm no new violations.
